rdfs:label: latitude
rdfs:comment: The latitude of a location, in decimal degrees (WGS-84).
notes: Decimal degrees, positive north of the equator. schema.org domain: GeoCoordinates or Place (so no rdfs:domain is declared here); schema.org range: Number or Text — give the value as a JSON number. Pair with `urn:solid:longitude` on a `urn:solid:GeoCoordinates` resource. For a single shorthand `geo:` URI carrying both, use `urn:solid:hasGeo`.

history.note: Example now uses JSON numbers; removed rdfs:domain GeoCoordinates (schema.org domain is GeoCoordinates or Place) and noted it.
